name: dependency-mapping
description: Surface and visualize hidden dependencies blocking delivery. Use when the user says "map our dependencies", "what's blocking what", "dependency audit", "why are teams blocked", "we have a bottleneck", "draw out the dependencies", or asks to identify cross-team blockers - even if they don't explicitly say "dependency mapping". Based on "Making Work Visible" by Dominica DeGrandis (time theft, invisible work, flow blockers).
